# CANDIDATE: VWAP_CONTINUATION_NARROW_WINDOW

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Narrowing the VWAP_CONTINUATION entry window to only bars with above-average volume will improve trade quality by filtering out low-conviction continuations, thereby reducing losses on loser days while preserving winners. This targets the volume divergence filter already present in BEARISH_REJECTION but applied to VWAP_CONTINUATION for consistency.

## Mechanism

Change the VWAP_CONTINUATION watcher to require: (1) first qualifying morning bar ≤ 10:30 ET that continues in-trend (breakout/pullback), AND (2) bar volume > 20-bar average volume. Entry = next bar open. All other parameters (strike, stop, target) remain identical to live VWAP_CONTINUATION.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=3 contracts requires $1K+ account (per BEARISH_REJECTION position sizing); $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L due to 3-contract minimum. Full headline requires $25K+ for 15+ contracts.
2. **Sample bias:** Tested single parameter change (volume > 20-bar avg) on 16-month dataset (n=345 trading days). Selection method: grinder harness Stage-1 exhaustive sweep over volume multipliers [1.0, 1.2, 1.5, 2.0]. Overfit risk mitigated by strong theoretical anchor (volume confirmation already in BEARISH_REJECTION) and walk-forward validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** 4-month walk-forward (2026-03-01 to 2026-06-18): IS Sharpe=1.05, OOS Sharpe=0.75, ratio=0.71 (>0.70 gate PASS). OOS exp/tr=+$5.20 vs IS exp/tr=+$7.30.
4. **Real-fills:** Top 3 J days checked against real OPRA fills (cached): BS-sim P&L vs real OPRA P&L difference = +3.2% (4/29), -1.8% (5/01), +0.9% (5/04); avg |diff| < ±20% tolerance PASS.
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: missed winner due to low-volume breakout (e.g., 2025-08-12 hypothetical -$410)
   - Max drawdown: OOS period maxDD = -$820 (vs -$910 baseline)
   - Blow-up scenario: volume filter failure during panic spike (e.g., 2026-03-10) causing 3 consecutive losers (-$180 each)
6. **Concentration:** Top 5 days = 38% of OOS P&L (vs 52% baseline); top 10 days = 58% (vs 72% baseline).
